description: This file contains a series of shell script commands and functions designed to test Git's notes functionality, particularly organized in subtrees or directories within the repository. It sets up test environments, creates commits, and verifies the correct association and retrieval of notes in various directory structures and concatenations.

methods.name: start_note_commit
methods.description: Initializes a commit object in Git with notes using 'git cat' and predefined commit data.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies that notes are correctly associated with commits by checking git log output.

methods.name: test_sha1_based
methods.description: Creates notes for each commit based on its SHA-1 hash, applying a sed transformation to determine note paths.

methods.name: test_same_notes
methods.description: Creates identical notes at different paths for each commit to test note consistency across paths.

methods.name: verify_concatenated_notes
methods.description: Checks that concatenated notes are correctly associated with commits by parsing 'git log'.
